offlineInstall: Copy opencode-win-x64-local.zip to the target computer.
Verify the SHA-256 checksum against this manifest after replacing TBD_AFTER_BUNDLE_BUILD.
Extract the archive into the configured runtime bundle directory.
Start the local OpenAI-compatible model server on http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 if opencode is configured to use it.
Open Runtime Dock in the Electron app and start the opencode terminal profile.
notes: The archive is intentionally not committed to git.
This manifest records the reproducible offline contract for the first opencode runtime bundle.
OpenIM hosts the terminal. opencode owns provider/model/API-key configuration.
